protocol.description: FailMem Single-Channel Blockage Protocol (v3.0 - Dual-Room Chokepoint, Natural Clearance & AMCL Nomotion Update)

obstacle_channel.geometry_rationale: Positioned directly inside the single central doorway at x=0.0 between Room 1 and Room 2, physically sealing the 0.90m doorway.

C1_continuous_blockage.name: Continuous Obstacle Blockage
C1_continuous_blockage.protocol_notes: Obstacle completely seals single doorway. Nav2 cannot pass or detour, timing out at 45.0s sim time without reaching goal.

C2_temporary_blockage_retry.name: Temporary Obstacle Blockage (Observe -> Initial Blocked Fail -> Delete -> Natural Raytrace Clear -> Valid Observe -> Retry)
C2_temporary_blockage_retry.protocol_notes: Obstacle spawned before initial navigate. Initial attempt fails genuinely due to blockage. Obstacle is deleted. Doorway clearance verified via map-frame spatial scan and costmap. Observe returns valid AMCL via nomotion update. Retry dispatched with restored parameters and successfully navigates through cleared doorway to Room 2 goal.

coordinate_alignment.transformation_convention: Image shape (100, 160) with origin [-4.0, -2.5, 0.0] and resolution 0.05 m/px. Continuous transform: x_map = -4.0 + u * 0.05, y_map = -2.5 + (100 - v) * 0.05.
coordinate_alignment.geometric_consistency_statement: All 6 static SDF landmarks align with PGM map obstacle centroids within bounded discretization error (max residual 0.0627m <= 0.0750m).
